notablePrerequisites:
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two additional creatures.
It is your upkeep.
description:
During your upkeep, activate Necrotic Ooze using Whisper's ability by tapping it and sacrificing two other creatures, returning Phyrexian Triniform from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Black Carriage's ability by sacrificing Phyrexian Triniform.
When Phyrexian Triniform dies, it triggers, creating three 3/3 Phyrexian Golem artifact creature tokens.
Resolve the Necrotic Ooze ability, untapping it.
Repeat.
